title: More Training Opportunities in Artificial Intelligence for Singaporean PMETs to Strengthen Overall Competitive Position
what_it_is: More Training Opportunities in Artificial Intelligence for Singaporean PMETs to Strengthen Overall Competitive Position

sections.label: AI worker training approach
sections.summary: The Government's approach to training workers in artificial intelligence was laid out in MDDI's responses to Parliamentary Questions, with an update to come at the MDDI Committee of Supply debate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: The Government's approach for training our workers, including professionals, managers, executives and technicians in artificial intelligence was laid out in the Ministry of Digital Development and Information's (MDDI's) responses to similar Parliamentary Questions filed by Members of Parliament Gerald Giam and Ang Wei Neng, which were published in the Hansard for the 9 January 2024 and 13 November 2024 Parliament Sittings respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: [Please refer to "Workers Facing Highest Risk of Displacement from Artificial Intelligence and Reskilling Programmes Available", Official Report, 9 January 2024, Vol 95, Issue 118, Written Answers to Questions section; and "Progress of Developing IT and AI Professionals through Career Conversion Programmes", Official Report, 13 November 2024, Vol 95, Issue 147, Oral Answers to Questions section.] We will be providing an update on our efforts at the upcoming MDDI Committee of Supply debate.
